unit: U3 object & sound (SCION #29 GrabCut; #45 occlusion, #41 secondary dynamics as methods)

shoe.note_for_editor: replace test-shot SHOE_FULL (old cut with a cast-shadow halo trimmed by hand) with this cut for the held shoe; draw it with the same rotation logic

layer.coords: P2 plane, wide framing, picture px, y down. Paste frame k at (0, dy) with dy = round(water_y(v, t) - 408) (per-frame list in retrieval.*.paste_dy_px_per_k); for a close at zoom Z map world->screen and scale the hi frame by Z/3 (<=1, downscale only)
layer.note: the shoe floats 16 px in front of the plank on the water plane (clearly separated from the plank and from B's face; never overlaps the bank card)

path.ease: u = 1.6 s - 0.6 s^2, s = t/3.6 (arrives with 0.4 of entry speed)

contact.response: recoil 4 px damped 1.6 Hz tau 0.35 s + 6 deg pitch kick

hand_occlusion.rule: #45 occlusion DAG: water < reflection < rings < shoe(submerged) < shoe(above water) < B's hand card. The editor draws B's R hand card ABOVE the layer for k 115-134; from k 135 (L 19.625 local / E 12.625) the shoe is absent from the layer and parented to B's hand (FK). No pop: the held shoe's first frame is drawn at the hand where the layer's last shoe frame was (dist <= 18.4 px).
hand_occlusion.region_world_px: per frame hand_card_box in retrieval.L/E.occlusion (hand R point +-16 px); union x 199.6-257.0, y 351.4-420.4

layer.after_grasp: k 135-149: ripple burst of the lift and three drip rings (k 139, 143, 148), no shoe

identity.rule: L uses k = round((local - 14.0)*24), E uses k = round((local - 7.0)*24): the same files; E is the L layer shifted -7.0 s (168 frames)
identity.hash_algorithm: sha256 of the PNG bytes and of the raw RGBA array

second_object.method: U2's render_ls5.frame() at L local 19.25 (reach), 19.62 (grasp), 20.2 (held at chest) with only the shoe image swapped (second_object.py); same affordance (graspable, one hand), different social reading (laced, beaded: harder to wear, more ornamental)
second_object.note: in these stills the floating shoe is still U2's approximate shoe_on_water (it sits on the plank line); in the film the SHOE-DRIFT-1 layer replaces it

handmade.what: GrabCut cutout of the right bar shoe (#29): rect + chroma seeds (neutral grey ground and cast shadow = background, warm satin/kid/sole = foreground), 5 graph-cut iterations, largest component, speckle holes filled, the ground under the arch kept open, brown sole edge regrown, 1 px erosion, inpainted edge decontamination, 0.8 px feather; then one neutral monotone curve (p2/p50/p99.5 -> L105/218/246, R=G=B)

handmade.what: same pipeline for the oxford (all enclosed holes filled: satin highlights read as ground)

the interruption layer: 150 RGBA frames at 24 fps rendered at 3x (layer_hi, world strip x -20..880, y 340..470) and area-downsampled to the wide 800x540 layer; Catmull-Rom drift from frame right (880,403) through (640,398) (430,406) to the grasp point x 237.34, arc-length parametrised, eased so it arrives still moving (u = 1.6s - 0.6s^2); bob +-3 px / 0.9 s; pitch rock 2.5 deg; contact at k 86 = a damped recoil (4 px, 1.6 Hz, tau 0.35 s) and pitch kick (#41: starts after the impulse, all energy decays); the hand's approach dips and stills the bob (k 115-134); reflection mirrored about the waterline, darkened, alpha-faded, re-rippled every frame by two travelling row-shift waves and broken by ripple troughs; broken ripple rings (12 dashes with seeded gaps, bright crest L205 over dark trough L40, aspect 0.13) born at bob troughs, at contact (3), at the hand entering the water (2), at the lift (2), and 3 drips; V wake while drifting; submerged 22 % tinted toward the water; above water immaculate white (no mud, ever: invariant 5)

kit.Mix synthesis (declared): plank creak = stick-slip impulse train 38->85 Hz through wood modes 182/413/737/1210 Hz, scaled by plank deflection, one per plank footfall (footfalls = end of each ankle's forward swing in U2's traces); wood step thump 96/231 Hz; mud step on the banks; shoe tap = heel knock with rebound 105 ms, hollow 520 Hz body, plip; card rustle = crackle grains 1.2-7 kHz + bag landing 105 Hz; pencil writing = stroke-enveloped graphite noise 2.2-8 kHz; strike-through = one 0.33 s scratch 1.2-6.5 kHz; liana fibre creak at each grip; drips (plips) at layer k 139/143/148
FALLBACK insect bed synthesized with kit.Mix (three AM noise-band voices 3.1/4.3/5.65 kHz + sparse chirps), -38 dBFS RMS, with the declared silences
fallback close lap: band-limited noise 150-900 Hz
fallback splash: noise 200-5000 Hz, exp decay
